## 3dslibris 3.1.0

A performance-focused update: quicker startup and library browsing, faster book preparation, and smoother reading, search and zoom controls.

### Speed improvements

- **Library:** quicker navigation, folder changes and cover loading, with less repeated work when sorting by title or author.
- **Opening books:** faster EPUB preparation and less copying when opening MOBI books. Reopening cached EPUBs skips unnecessary archive work.
- **Reading:** faster page turns and redraws, including centered/right-aligned text, code and footnotes.
- **PDF/CBZ/XPS:** quicker page-fit previews and scaling, plus less repeated drawing in wide mode. PDF/CBZ panning updates only the moving preview border and keeps the clock/page counter visible.
- **Search:** speed improvements when finding words and phrases, with regular cancellation checks and preserved accent/word-boundary matching.
- **Illustrations:** quicker repeated zoom and pan, with steady controls. Opaque inline images use half the cached pixel memory; transparent images still blend correctly with the page.

### Measured examples

| What was measured | Before → after | Improvement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| App initialization, before the first library draw | 2.00 → 0.99 s | About 50% less time |
| First preparation of a 7,607-page EPUB | 94.5 → 55.3 s | About 41% less time |
| EPUB page turns: two matching turns | 285 → 260 ms median | About 9% less time |
| PDF page turns: ten matching turns at equivalent zoom | 440 → 273 ms median | About 38% less time |
| CBZ page turns: ten matching turns | 1.48 → 1.39 s median | About 7% less time |
| Scaling the CBZ preview | 87 → 60 ms | About 30% less time in this step |
| Full-book search with no match: a 405-page EPUB | 47.0 → 5.7 s | About 88% less time |

These are small **Azahar debug** samples, not hardware benchmarks or guaranteed speedups for every book. Other speed improvements have not yet been quantified with matching before/after runs.

### Fixes and updating

- Keep custom font selections working and restore bookmarks without duplicating them.
- Preserve reading progress, preferences, image transparency, page proportions and wide-screen detail.
- Build the new metadata index from existing caches as needed; no manual cache deletion is required.

Loading very large page caches remains a bottleneck: the 7,607-page EPUB still took about **21 seconds** to reopen with its cache. See the [performance checklist](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/blob/main/docs/PERFORMANCE_SMOKE_TEST.md) for comparison and regression tests, including HOME and suspend/resume on hardware.

### Downloads

- `3dslibris.cia` or `3dslibris.3dsx` for normal use.
- `3dslibris-sdmc.zip`: runtime files for Homebrew Launcher installs; use with the `.3dsx` download.
- Debug builds (`3dslibris-debug.cia` / `3dslibris-debug.3dsx`) and `3dslibris-source.tar.gz` are also included.

Thanks to everyone trying the builds and reporting issues. You can support the project with a ⭐ on GitHub or [a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rigle).
